summary: Pembina Pipeline Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing renewal of its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 5% of outstanding common shares (29,071,759 shares) via open-market purchases on TSX, NYSE, or alternative venues, starting May 19, 2026 through May 18, 2027. Shares repurchased will be cancelled. The program is opportunistic, driven by management's view that shares may trade below intrinsic value, with purchases subject to financial guardrails, available cash flow, and risk-adjusted returns versus capital investments or debt reduction. Maximum daily purchases on TSX limited to 25% of six-month average daily trading volume (693,233 shares). Prior NCIB expired with zero repurchases. Watch actual buyback execution pace and capital allocation trade-offs with dividends or projects.
